questions.question: E3M1's largest recovered surface spans 57 records of tile 100. Only 31% of the map's records sit in a shared projection at all. Should the writer keep projecting one frame per RUN, or per FLAT FACE, which is what E3M1 does (88% of collinear joins continue, 15-51% of bends, 13% of reflex corners)?
questions.recommended_default: keep the run, and add nothing: RUN_BREAK_DEGREES already stops at 100 degrees, and the reader's census is the evidence for whether a bend break belongs in the writer too. Decide it on the whole campaign, not on E3M1

questions.question: 2481 records, 1075 of them with no same-material neighbour at all. Is a lone record a SURFACE of one, or is it evidence that our surface model does not fit how Blood was authored?
questions.recommended_default: count it as residue, as here: a frame fitted to one record reproduces it for free, and calling that understanding is how a coverage report reaches 100%
